kill_history.detail: Spearman(core6, median_margin) = +1.00, exact p = 0.0028; Spearman(core6, frac<0.005) = -1.00, exact p = 0.0028 -- both at n=6 exact-permutation lower bound

kill_history.downgrade_reason: The ladder confounds damage level with training budget, so neither a positive nor a negative correlation over it is attributable to damage. Among the 5 damaged rungs: Spearman(core6, heal_steps) = +0.8944 while Spearman(core6, layers_kept) = -0.3536 -- budget outranks damage AND has the better sign. layers_kept takes only TWO values across damaged rungs (14 at four rungs, 16 at one), so there is almost no damage-depth rank variation to correlate. Holding damage completely constant inside the f12k2/14L cell still spans core6 0.3848 -> 0.4632 (spread 0.0783) purely on 2k vs 20k vs 200k steps, which is 66.1% of the 0.1185 spread across all five damaged rungs. The step20000 non-monotonicity that the original verdict called the story-breaker sits exactly on that budget axis.
kill_history.detail: Original measurement retained and unchanged: same metrics on the Qwen3-8B six-rung ladder give rho = +0.43 (p=0.42) and -0.49 (p=0.36) vs OLMo's +-1.00 (exact p=0.0028). Rungs are still core6-ordered, so aggregate degradation replicates. What is withdrawn is the INFERENCE that the rho collapse shows damage failing to compress per-item margins.
kill_history.only_damage_attributable_contrast: the equal-budget slice at 2000 steps (f12k2/14L, f12k4/16L, scratch14L) -- n=3, exact-permutation two-sided minimum p = 2/6 = 0.3333, so it cannot reach significance at any conventional alpha regardless of the data, and it varies two architectural factors at once. Neither confirms nor kills.
kill_history.consequence: Cross-family generality is now UNTESTED, not refuted. This is NOT a promotion -- see status_note_2026_08_10.

status_note_2026_08_10.olmo_leg_is_less_confounded_not_unconfou: Disclosed for symmetry: the OLMo ladder is also budget-varying -- Spearman(core6, heal_steps) = +0.8721 across its 5 damaged rungs (steps 83500/121000/124000/200000). The difference that licenses its claim is that OLMo's damage depth spans FIVE distinct values (8/10/12/14/16) and is a PERFECT rank predictor of core6 (rho = +1.0000), i.e. it has a real damage axis, whereas Qwen's damage depth spans two values and predicts worse than budget. Wherever the OLMo rho=+1.00 is quoted, the +0.8721 budget correlation should be quoted with it.
status_note_2026_08_10.qwen_readmitted_as_candidate_family: The prior resurrection condition said 'NOT Qwen; that has already failed'. That clause is WITHDRAWN because Qwen was never fairly tested. matched_ladder_requirements: budget held constant across damaged rungs; report Spearman(core6, heal_steps) ~ 0 alongside the headline rho
>=4 distinct damage levels so layers_kept has real rank variation (OLMo's 8/10/12/14/16 is the shape to match)
one damage axis at a time -- do not vary fresh-block width and init inside the correlation ladder
n >= 6 rungs to keep the exact-permutation two-sided floor at 2/720 = 0.0028
identical harness and identical item set across rungs (existing runs already satisfy this: n=17195 each, per-item norm_scores asserted)
reuse the already-designated PRIMARY metric frac(margin<0.005); do not pick post hoc among the four thresholds
status_note_2026_08_10.cost_note: The budget-matching requirement means re-healing Qwen rungs to a common step count rather than reusing existing checkpoints. This downgrade does NOT authorise that spend; it records what the spend would buy. B04 stays in backlog, so there is no reason to run it before the mechanism-level hypothesis exists.
status_note_2026_08_10.disclosure: No new threshold was invented. +0.8944 and the 0.661 within-cell ratio are descriptive statistics of the existing design, not tests against a cutoff. The judgement -- that a correlation better explained by a nuisance factor than by the factor of interest cannot license a claim about the factor of interest -- was made AFTER seeing the data, on 2026-08-10, by re-reading an already-published verdict. The original gate design should have required the matching conditions up front and did not.

kill_gate.clause_1_bs_ladder: SUPERSEDED. status/PAPERF_BS_LADDER_VERDICT.md returned FLIP_RATE_MONOTONE=UNTESTABLE at 2/6 rungs, and status/PAPERB_WITHIN_DISK_FLOOR_V3.md shows same-driver same-arch re-runs are BIT-DETERMINISTIC (0 flips) -- so a bs8-vs-bs16 flip ladder has a structurally near-zero denominator and cannot carry the claim. kill_gate.clause_2_exact_test: Spearman(core6, median_margin) over the 6-rung wzc1 sm_100 ladder must be rho = +1.0000 with exact two-sided permutation p = 0.0028 (= 2/720, the n=6 floor). Measured 2026-08-14: rho=+1.0000, p=0.0028. PASS, already banked.
kill_gate.clause_3_beats_null: Full-damaged-ladder range of median_margin must be >= 6 * sigma_hat, where sigma_hat comes from the seed pair. Threshold 6 chosen so the range survives even if sigma_hat is under-estimated by 3x (n=2 gives a very loose sigma). Measured: range 0.021820 over the 5 damaged rungs = 40.3 * sigma_hat. PASS, already banked.
kill_gate.clause_4_second_nuisance: WITHDRAWN as a kill clause, DEMOTED to a reported robustness check. Reason: the only available second nuisance axis (torch/GPU arch) is exactly the axis LIFECYCLE_SCHEMA.md sec 3 forbids crossing for same-harness reproduction, and status/PAPERB_WITHIN_DISK_FLOOR_V3.md shows the within-arch term is identically zero, so 'replicates across arch' would be testing stack drift, not fragility. Retaining it as a kill clause would let a stack-version artefact kill a real finding.
kill_gate.clause_5_budget_discrimination_THE_LIVE_: This is the only clause not yet run and the only one that can still kill B04. See next_gate. The margin-compression claim is attributed to DAMAGE DEPTH. But on the same wzc1 ladder Spearman(core6, heal_steps) = +0.6669 across the 5 damaged rungs (steps 200000/200000/111500/83500/121000; recomputed 2026-08-14, and note this is NOT the +0.8721 in status_note_2026_08_10, which was computed on the zwfy6 ladder whose keep12 rung is step124000 -- both must be disclosed with their ladder identified). Heal budget is therefore a live alternative explanation. Clause 5 measures the budget slope DIRECTLY at fixed damage and requires it to be small relative to the damage slope.
kill_gate.statement: B04 is KILLED if, on the fixed-damage budget ladder (keep14+fresh2 seed1234 at heal steps 25000/50000/100000/128000/200000 -- damage depth held EXACTLY at keep_front=14, n_fresh=2), the median_margin excursion attributable to heal budget alone, rescaled to the damaged ladder's own heal-step span of 116500 steps, reaches or exceeds 60% of the damaged ladder's total median_margin range of 0.021820.
kill_gate.threshold: phi = |beta_budget| * 116500 / 0.021820 >= 0.60 => KILL. phi <= 0.30 => PASS. 0.30 < phi < 0.60 => NARROWED (claim must be restated as 'damage and heal budget jointly compress margins', family-generality spend stays unauthorised). beta_budget = OLS slope of median_margin on heal_step over the 5 fixed-damage points, units margin-per-step; the threshold in absolute margin units is Delta_budget = 0.006546 (phi=0.30) and 0.013092 (phi=0.60). Why 0.60: at phi>=0.60 the nuisance factor explains more of the observed range than the factor of interest does, which is the exact standard status_note_2026_08_10.disclosure already applied to retire the Qwen leg ('a correlation better explained by a nuisance factor than by the factor of interest cannot license a claim about the factor of interest'). Why 0.30: it is 6*sigma_hat/0.021820 = 0.149 rounded up to twice the floor, so a PASS means the budget excursion is not merely resolvable-but-small, it is small with a 2x margin over resolvability.
kill_gate.comparator: The damaged-rung span of the wzc1 sm_100 6-rung ladder: olmo2_downstream_results/{7B_shortgpt16_step200000_wzc1, 7B_keep14_step200000_wzc1_v2, 7B_keep12_step111500_wzc1, 7B_keep10_step83500_wzc1, 7B_keep8_step121000_wzc1}, median_margin 0.116599 -> 0.094779, range 0.021820, heal-step span 116500. NOT compared against 'a baseline' -- against this named 5-arm set.
kill_gate.denominator_guard: phi is a ratio; its denominator is the damaged-ladder range 0.021820. (a) The denominator is only admissible if it clears the floor: range >= 6*sigma_hat = 0.0032435. Measured 0.021820 = 6.73x the guard. PASS. (b) If the denominator were <= 0 or below 6*sigma_hat, phi is UNDEFINED, not large and not small, and the gate returns DENOMINATOR_UNRESOLVED -- which blocks the family-ladder spend exactly as a KILL would, because a ratio against an unresolved range cannot license 244-2560 GPU-h. (c) sigma_hat itself is a denominator in the floor check and is ill-defined at n=1: it may only be formed from >= 2 arms holding damage depth AND heal step EXACTLY constant, using divisor E[range of k]/sigma = 1.1284 at k=2 (1.6926 at k=3, 2.8472 at k=8; using 1.0 understates the floor by 11.4% and can flip the boolean -- memory/a-range-is-not-a-measurement-until-it-clears-its-floor.md). (d) If sigma_hat computes to exactly 0 -- the normal outcome for same-driver re-runs per status/PAPERB_WITHIN_DISK_FLOOR_V3.md -- the gate returns FLOOR_UNMEASURABLE and does NOT pass; that means the contrast is not a real nuisance contrast. The seed pair is safe here: it varies init seed and gives non-zero sigma_hat on all 4 metrics (median_margin |delta|=0.000610 -> 0.000541).
kill_gate.what_result_stops_the_work: beta_budget large enough that phi >= 0.60. Concretely: if median_margin on the fixed-damage budget ladder moves by >= 0.013092 across a 116500-step-equivalent budget change, then heal budget alone reproduces >= 60% of what B04 attributes to damage depth, the OLMo leg falls to the SAME defect that retired the Qwen leg (DIRECTION_A_QWEN_LADDER_CONFOUND_ADDENDUM.md), and B04 folds into the Paper B methods appendix per olmo_only_finding.recommended_home. The 244-2560 GPU-h matched-family ladder is then never run.
